notes: The update endpoint (services_proxy/bank/customers/update/{id}) answers 200 with a plain-text body while claiming Content-Type: application/json, so the page’s own jQuery call fails to parse it as JSON and is routed through its AJAX error handler even on a genuine success — the handler specifically checks status === 200 to show the success panel anyway. Confirmed by making the raw request directly: status 200, body "Successfully updated customer profile", and the customer record was verified changed on a follow-up GET. This is app behaviour, not a bug in the test — the generated spec does not need to route around it, since the app’s own script already does.
